name: Jonkoping County (Sweden)

colors.symbolism: the chief with three golden crowns

description: A banner of the county arms: a red chief bearing three golden crowns above a blue field with a white castle over waves.
history: The flag is the heraldic banner of the arms of Jonkoping County, granted in 1945 and combining the historic arms of the provinces of Smaland and Vastergotland that make up the county.

features.role: banner of the arms of Jonkoping County
